aspects.name: Arcane
aspects.presentation: You exhibit characteristics like unnatural horns, bone protrusions, or swirls of bright colors upon your skin.

aspects.name: Beast
aspects.presentation: You display features of the animal to which you are closest. These animals must be mammals, birds or reptiles.

aspects.name: Construct
aspects.presentation: Your costume and makeup should show the substance you are infused with.

aspects.name: Divine
aspects.presentation: You have metallic (gold, silver, copper) coloration upon your face.

aspects.name: Elemental
aspects.presentation: Your makeup should display elemental focused makeup in the color to which you are attuned, Earth (brown), Air / Wind (White), Lightning (Yellow), Fire (red) or Water / Ice (blue).

aspects.name: Ghost
aspects.presentation: Your makeup should include whites and grays to show your ties to the grave.

aspects.name: Life
aspects.presentation: None required. You may, at your discretion, have exaggerated ears, or teeth.

aspects.name: Plant
aspects.presentation: The flora is a part of you, and you display their nature upon you.

aspects.name: Shade
aspects.presentation: You have a bit of the shade within you and show those bits upon your face including Constellations, Heraldrics, Shade locations and other Shade beings. This aspect more than any other is very diverse as there are many parts of the shade.

foundations.detail: Modules: An adventure led by an NPC or through a gate that includes less than 12 PCs
foundations.name: Heroic

foundations.detail: Field Battles: Any large-scale combat encounter including more than 12 PCs
foundations.name: Military

foundations.detail: Interacting with or discussion of villains
foundations.name: Reformed

foundations.detail: Any time you pass through a gate, but not outside of the World
foundations.name: Traveler

hidden.name: Cursebreaker
hidden.primarySkill: Ritual Curse Removal

hidden.name: Deadeye
hidden.primarySkill: Take ten seconds without moving to increase the damage of your archery attack

hidden.name: Fletcher
hidden.primarySkill: You can quickly refresh the quiver of another

hidden.name: Fortress
hidden.primarySkill: Grant Protection to another

hidden.name: Guardian
hidden.primarySkill: Your healing towards the person you designate as your Ward is increased

hidden.name: Guildsmember
hidden.primarySkill: Gain additional resources or special resources each event

hidden.name: Lightfoot
hidden.primarySkill: Gain additional damage and defenses by moving while you shoot

hidden.name: Mindblade
hidden.primarySkill: Melee strikes using mental and an increasing arsenal of traits

hidden.name: Monsoon
hidden.primarySkill: Single Sword healer who can both attack and heal

hidden.name: Order Adherent
hidden.primarySkill: Specific to each unique Convocation

hidden.name: Poison arrow
hidden.primarySkill: Create curative potions and venoms that can be affixed to your arrows

hidden.name: Preserver
hidden.primarySkill: Once you are hit by a specific trait you become better at resisting that trait

hidden.name: Reconstructor
hidden.primarySkill: You can heal yourself and benefit from healing more than the norm

hidden.name: Reservoir
hidden.primarySkill: You know how to create a place of healing that you and your companions can return to for beneficial effects.

hidden.name: Scorpion, who mixes poisons at the point of centering to harm others while using the scorpion's chiton to protect themselves.
hidden.primarySkill: You mix poisons to strike your enemy and elixirs to protect yourself. You benefit from your own mixtures.

hidden.name: Shadewalker
hidden.primarySkill: Gain knowledge of the shade and be better able to travel there

hidden.name: Steelforge
hidden.primarySkill: Without your five foot circle your defenses are greatly enhanced

hidden.name: Transgressor
hidden.primarySkill: Can cast detrimental effects against their foes

hidden.name: Trick Shot
hidden.primarySkill: Switch between spells and missile attacks.

hidden.name: Vampire
hidden.primarySkill: When you strike your foes you heal

hidden.name: War Dancer
hidden.primarySkill: An individual who gains strength in alternating between melee and missile attacks

hidden.name: Whisperer
hidden.primarySkill: They combine protections and packet attacks equally.

skills.description: You have an additional Attribute (Choose one attribute of your choice of either Prowess, Insight, or Fortitude).
skills.name: Extra Attribute

skills.description: You gain a special weapon. See details in Aspect Armament Skills section.
skills.name: Aspect Armaments

skills.description: Once per event, when you take this skill choose melee, missile, or packet. The <Trait> is the Trait you chose when you selected your Aspect.
skills.name: Blast Aspect

skills.description: Once per event, you can Purge an effect that has the Will trait.
skills.name: Unravel Magic

skills.description: Once per event, you can change the effect Trait of any non-per event Skill to the name of your Aspect (i.e., Spirit, Arcane, Shade, etc). **This is an extra Thread Skill.**
skills.name: Invoke Aspect

skills.description: Once per Short Rest, you can use the ability 'Speak to' <Aspect> where aspect represents your aspect.
skills.name: Tongue of Aspect

skills.description: Once per event, if you are affected by a 'Frenzy' effect, you can attack your enemies if there are enemies around, if there are no enemies around, you will then attack your allies.
skills.name: Aspect Fury

skills.description: If your armor has clear detailing that shows your aspect (Faux Fur for beast, Fake plants for Plant, Celestial Star patterns for Shade, etc) treat the armor as being worth one additional point of armor. This point cannot take you over the maximum number of armor points your skills allow.
skills.name: Aspect Armor

skills.description: Once per event, when using a healing effect, you can increase the effect by 2 and change the effect to 'By Aspect'. **This effect is an extra Thread Skill.**
skills.name: Enhanced Healing

skills.description: When you use any beneficial skill, you may change the trait to 'By <Trait>'. The <Trait> is the Trait you chose when you selected your Aspect.
skills.name: Channel Aspect

skills.description: Once per Long Rest, when you are affected by your chosen Trait, you can instead say 'Absorb to Heal 2'.
skills.name: Absorb Elements

skills.description: When you share something of value from your culture (like a meal, drinks, or appreciation of cultural art or music) with another player who isn't of your culture, you both gain a 'Guard' effect to the next called melee, missile, or packet attack that strikes you.
skills.name: Appreciation

skills.description: Once per event, when you see someone else of your culture in trouble, you can bolster them by reminding them of a value of your homeland and using a touch packet to heal them and restore their armor.
skills.name: Camaraderie

skills.description: Once per event, when you dress in the style of your culture, your clothing takes on additional protection. This allows you to excede the maximum number of armor points normally available to you. This effect ends when you take your next Long Rest or change out of that outfit.
skills.name: Garb

skills.description: Once per event, when you travel to your homeland, you gain an extra point of Prowess, Insight, or Fortitude. This point is lost when you take your next Long Rest or leave your homeland.
skills.name: Homeland

skills.description: Once per event, when you act in a manner that exemplifies your culture (something you feel meets the style and mannerisms defined in the cultural writeup), you can gain a grant attack (melee, missile, or spell) for yourself or another.
skills.name: Practice

skills.description: You have individuals you can contact via Courier as someone you know. They provide access to research.
skills.name: Resource/Contacts

skills.description: When you take a Short Rest you gain three Archery attacks of 2 damage.
skills.name: Air's Determination

skills.description: When you take a Short Rest, your next Missile attack that costs an attribute to use is free.
skills.name: Air's Touch

skills.description: You can refresh your quiver in 30 seconds instead of a minute.
skills.name: Air's Grace

skills.description: Your quiver can hold 10 arrows instead of 5. In addition, once per Short Rest, you can refresh your quiver with a 10-second Rest.
skills.name: Air's Skill

skills.description: Once per event, you can shoot an archery attack of '6 damage.'
skills.name: Air's Last Stand

skills.description: Once per event, you can instantly reset your quiver and gain the effect of Air's Touch at the same time without the need for Rest.
skills.name: Air's Gift

skills.description: Once per event, when you are hit by a missile or packet attack, call out 'Resist' to negate the attack.
skills.name: Air's Shield

skills.description: When you make a Missile Attack which does 4 damage or greater, add 1 to the total.
skills.name: Empower Air

skills.description: When you use a skill which provides multiple Missile damage attacks, you gain 1 extra Missile Attack.
skills.name: Enhance Air

skills.description: When you complete First Aid on an Unconscious person, you can also heal them for 1 Vitality.
skills.name: Earth's Determination

skills.description: If you are: (1) at a Place of Peace, (2) you take a Short Rest, and (3) are Centered, you gain two uses of 'heal 2,' and 'grant 2 Protection by [your Trait].'
skills.name: Earth's Touch

skills.description: Each time you center, you gain a point of Protection.
skills.name: Earth's Grace

skills.description: You gain double from any Skill which provides resources or coin.
skills.name: Earth's Skill

skills.description: Once per event, if you are Centered, you can take Spirit form for up to one minute. (See rules on Spirit form).
skills.name: Earth's Last Stand

skills.description: Once per event, you may 'Imbue Centered' to self to instantly become Centered.
skills.name: Earth's Gift

skills.description: Once per event, when you are hit by a packet or missile effect, you can say 'Resist' to negate the attack.
skills.name: Earth's Shield

skills.description: While Centered, your grant Protection or heal effects of 2 or higher are increased by 1.
skills.name: Empower Earth

skills.description: While Centered, your Skills which allow you to give two or more grant effects gain 1 additional effect.
skills.name: Enhance Earth

skills.description: When you take a Short Rest, you gain three packet attacks of 2 Damage by Fire.
skills.name: Fire's Determination

skills.description: When you take a short rest, your next Non-Beneficial Packet attack that costs an attribute to use is free.
skills.name: Fire's Touch

skills.description: Once each Short Rest, you can call 'Surge' and refresh your packet Flurry.
skills.name: Fire's Grace

skills.description: You can use packet attacks while you have a staff or Basic single-handed weapon in one hand.
skills.name: Fire's Skill

skills.description: Once per event, you can cast an effect of '6 damage by Fire.' Twice per event you can call 'Surge' and refresh your packet Flurry.
skills.name: Fire's Last Stand

skills.description: Once per Long Rest, when you miss with a packet attack which is a one-time per-event Skill, you can rest for 10 seconds to regain that ability. You cannot use this Skill on Skills that have multiple effects, nor can you use this Skill if you used another Skill that is triggered by missing your target.
skills.name: Fire's Gift

skills.description: Once per event, you can point at a target and Repel them using your Trait. Twice per event you can call 'Surge' and refresh your packet Flurry.
skills.name: Fire's Shield

skills.description: When you cast an offensive packet attack which does 4 damage or greater, add 1 to the total.
skills.name: Empower Fire

skills.description: When you use a Skill which provides multiple packet damage attacks, you gain one extra packet attack.
skills.name: Enhance Fire

skills.description: When you take a Short Rest, gain three uses of 'Repair 1 Armor to self'.
skills.name: Ice's Determination

skills.description: When you take a Short Rest, gain three uses of 'Repair 1 Armor'. This can stack with Ice's Determination.
skills.name: Ice's Touch

skills.description: Once per short rest, you can Resist an effect which would destroy your shield or armor.
skills.name: Ice's Grace

skills.description: You gain the ability to use Heavy Armor. Prerequisite: medium armor.
skills.name: Ice's Skill

skills.description: Once per event, heal 5 and repair 5 armor to self.
skills.name: Ice's Last Stand
skills.verbal: Heal 5 and Repair 5 armor to self

skills.description: Up to three times per event, you can 'Grant 2 Protection' to yourself or another.
skills.name: Ice's Gift

skills.description: Once per event, when you would have fallen due to called damage, you instead remain standing with one Vitality.
skills.name: Ice's Shield

skills.description: Your effects that 'heal to self' for 2 or greater are increased by 1 point. Say 'Increase' when you use this effect.
skills.name: Empower Ice

skills.description: You apply a Thread Skill to your armor that reduces attacks that do 5 or more damage by one point. This skill requires that you wear heavy armor. Say "Reduce" when you use this skill.
skills.name: Enhance Ice

skills.description: When you take a Short Rest, you gain three Melee attacks of 2 Damage.
skills.name: Lightning's Determination

skills.description: When you take a Short Rest, your next Melee attack that costs an attribute to use is free.
skills.name: Lightning's Touch

skills.description: Once per Short Rest you gain the ability to resist a 'Destroy weapon' effect.
skills.name: Lightning's Grace

skills.description: You gain the ability to use your called melee weapon attacks 'by Force' in place of the default weapon trait. Additionally, you gain the ability to fight with the following weapon styles: two one-handed weapons, spear and one-handed weapon, spear and buckler.
skills.name: Lightning's Skill

skills.description: Once per event, you can make a melee attack of '6 damage.'
skills.name: Lightning's Last Stand

skills.description: Twice per event, you can grant a melee attack of 3 damage to yourself or another.
skills.name: Lightning's Gift

skills.description: Once per event, you can negate a melee attack by calling 'Parry.'
skills.name: Lightning's Shield

skills.description: When you make a melee attack which does 4 damage or greater, add 1 to the total.
skills.name: Empower Lightning

skills.description: When you use a Skill which provides multiple melee damage attacks, you gain 1 extra melee attack.
skills.name: Enhance Lightning

skills.description: When you take a Short Rest, you gain five 'Heal 1 by <Trait>' beneficial effects.
skills.name: Water's Determination

skills.description: When you take a Short Rest, your next beneficial effect skill that costs an attribute to use is free
skills.name: Water's Touch

skills.description: Once per Short Rest, when you use a skill (other than First Aid) with a Cure effect you improve the effect to 'Cure X and heal 2'
skills.name: Water's Grace

skills.description: You can use packets (beneficial or non-beneficial) while you have a staff or single-handed weapon in your off hand.
skills.name: Water's Skill

skills.description: Once per event you can use a touch packet to heal someone else. Twice per event you can call 'Surge' and refresh your packet Flurry.
skills.name: Water's Last Stand

skills.description: Once per event you can cure a single physical, mental, elemental, or metabolic effect to someone else. Twice per event you can call 'Surge' and refresh your packet Flurry.
skills.name: Water's Gift
skills.verbal: Cure Physical, Mental, Elemental, or Metabolic by [Your Trait]

skills.description: Once per event you can grant 4 protection to someone else. Twice per event you can call 'Surge' and refresh your packet Flurry.
skills.name: Water's Shield

skills.description: When you cast a healing effect which does 2 or more add 1 to the total
skills.name: Empower Water

skills.description: When you use a skill which provides multiple healing effects, you gain one extra effect.
skills.name: Enhance Water

skills.description: You may choose a 3rd aspect for your character. You also gain one of the following three abilities which can be performed by any of your three Aspect Traits: **Bane** - Spend an attribute to make a 5 Damage Packet, Melee, or Missile Attack; **Balm** - Spend an attribute to make a touch packet of heal 5; **Repulse** – Spend an attribute to make a Packet, Melee, or Missile Attack of Repel
skills.name: Third Aspect

skills.description: Once per Long Rest, when you are presented with a source of any of your aspects (This is a role play decision based on your aspect choice) you can spend 10 seconds of rest at the source and restore all your vitality.
skills.name: Gather Aspect

skills.description: Once per event, after taking a Long Rest you can refresh a single 1x / event skill you used.
skills.name: Commune with Aspects

skills.description: You may purchase an additional 3 abilities from your list of available aspect abilities.
skills.name: Aspect Versatility

skills.description: When you dress in the style of your culture you gain +1 point of value for the armor type you are wearing.
skills.name: Garb

skills.description: You may use your culture as your beneficial trait for effects. When you use your culture as your beneficial trait for healing effects, they are increased by 1.
skills.name: Bringing the Good Word of the Country

skills.description: 1x / Long Rest you can turn to spirit & go directly to someone you can see who you know to be the same culture as you.
skills.name: The Ties That Bind

skills.description: You may purchase an additional 3 abilities from your list of available cultural abilities
skills.name: Cultural Versatility

skills.description: When you purchase this skill you choose Benign or Malevolent. **If you choose Benign,** you can convert all Beneficial effects you use to your Chosen Aspect Trait. As an additional effect from this skill, you also gain a +1 to healing or +1 to repair armor effects from Domain skills by your Chosen Aspect Trait. **If you choose Malevolent,** you can convert all non-beneficial called effects to Chosen Aspect Trait. As an additional effect from this skill, you also gain a +1 to damage effects from your Domain skills by your Chosen Aspect Trait.
skills.name: Channel Aspect

skills.description: You gain the Aspect weapon skill of one of your Aspects and your Aspect weapons are immune to Destroy Effects and Disarm Effects.
skills.name: Greater Aspect Weapons

skills.description: When you purchase this skill choose Melee, Missile or Packet attack. Spend one attribute to make an attack of that type for 6 damage by [Chosen Aspect Trait].
skills.name: Greater Aspect Attack

skills.description: You can "Absorb to Heal 2", "Cure" or "Purge" an effect by Your Chosen Aspect Trait.
skills.name: Greater Aspect Balm

skills.description: Select a second culture. This grants you the trait for your second culture. You may now choose to purchase skills from that culture as well as your first. You also gain the ability to grant strength to those of any of your cultures. Spend an attribute point and use a touch packet of 'Grant (melee, missile, or packet) attack to Culture '5 Damage by Presence''
skills.name: Dual Citizenship

skills.description: Select a third culture. This grants you the trait for your third culture. You may now choose to purchase skills from that culture as well as your first two. You also gain the ability to save those of your chosen nations. You can use this skill on any who share a culture that you have: Once per event make a touch packet of "Cure Death to Culture"
skills.name: Multinational

skills.description: Say a short phrase or otherwise perform an action in a manner that exemplifies your culture (something you feel meets the style and mannerisms defined in the cultural writeup) to grant an attack (melee, missile or magic) for yourself or another.
skills.name: Spreading Appreciation

skills.description: You gain an additional point of one attribute of your choice (Prowess, Fortitude or Insight).
skills.name: Hardy Traveler

skills.description: Do a reading in a Place of Peace. Based on your interpretation, choose one of these: 1. 'Grant 2 protection by Trance'. Followed by 'Grant 2 protection to self by Trance' 2. 'Grant melee attack 2 damage.' Followed by 'Grant melee attack 2 damage to self by Trance.' 3. 'Grant heal 2 by Trance'. Followed by 'Grant heal 2 to self by Trance'
skills.name: Prophecy

skills.description: Grants from the skill prophecy are all increased by +1
skills.name: Greater Prophecy

skills.description: Once per Short Rest you can heal one of those whose fortunes you told this gather as your vision predicted their time of need. Make a beneficial packet attack to heal the target.
skills.name: Healing a friend

skills.description: Listen to a tale from a group who went on an adventure you were not on. You may send an info skill about that adventure. This counts as an additional info skill beyond your normal two. The format of this skill should describe the adventure you were told about and then a question related to what occurred during the adventure.
skills.name: Hear a new tale

skills.description: You can enchant a dwelling, so that everyone who sleeps there gains 2 protection when they awaken and leave the dwelling. Put a sign on the door of the dwelling which reminds people of this effect.
skills.name: Empowered Time of Rest
skills.verbal: Grant 2 protection to self by Sleep

skills.description: One time per event, when you sit with someone else to eat a full meal you can "Grant one Vitality" to yourself and your companion.
skills.name: Empowered Feast

skills.description: Once per Long Rest, when you are an audience for a performance you can imbue the performer by clapping and then speaking with the performer afterwards, complimenting their work and refreshing one Prowess, Insight, or Fortitude to them.
skills.name: Empowered Audience
skills.verbal: Refresh 1 <choose Prowess, Insight or Fortitude> by Harmony

skills.description: When, in a Place of Peace, you play or watch a game of up to 6 people, at the end of the round you can 'Heal All' to everyone in the game.
skills.name: Empowered Game

skills.description: After a Short Rest, spend an attribute for a Guard, that will block the first called melee, missile, or packet attack, thereby warding off misfortune from yourself. After a Long Rest you gain a Guard without spending the attribute.
skills.name: Ward Misfortune
skills.verbal: Grant Guard to Self by Trance

skills.description: You gain an additional point of Purpose. In addition, if a vision is presented to you by plot, you can fully refresh one of Prowess, Insight, or Fortitude.
skills.name: Certainty is Strength

skills.description: You saw this moment where you might die and prepared for it. Either, If you are unstable and hit 59 seconds, you can spend an attribute and stabilize. Additionally, if you are hit by a death effect, spend 1 Prowess to reduce the effect to '10 damage'
skills.name: Avoid Ill fortune
skills.verbal: Stabilize to Self' or 'Reduce to 10 Damage

skills.description: If you listen to a PC's story (for more than 30 seconds) about something they have done this gather in a Place of Peace you can call upon the gravitas of their actions to remove their wounds and your own. Make a beneficial packet attack to heal them.
skills.name: Erase the wounds of the past

skills.description: Write your research skill in the following way: I don't know the exact question I'm looking to ask, but I want to accomplish something plot relevant. Example: Who can I talk to about this thing? Or I'm trying to learn something impactful about <Insert Name> plot?
skills.name: See the Question

skills.description: When you are affected by the silence spell you can still use skills and spells that normally require a verbal. You must say a short phrase in gibberish before you call the effect.
skills.name: Speak in Tongues

skills.description: When you are in the tavern drinking with a group of companions of no more than 6 total, you can grant 2 protection to the group.
skills.name: Drinking away the future

skills.description: You gain the ability to start a negotiation with Shade beings. Your group takes on Spirit form and you and your entire group can approach the Shade being and say 'Negotiations' If they say 'No Effect' you must return to your previous location and then lose your spirit effect. If they accept the Negotiation, you can continue to speak and are a spirit until negotiations end. At which point you return to your starting point as a spirit.
skills.name: Blessed of the Constellations

skills.description: When in a Place of Peace, grant 2 protection to one person. Alternatively when you use this skill after giving a Performance you can grant to all performers.
skills.name: Protective Performance

skills.description: When you return from an adventure you may sing a short song or tell a short tale to set the scene of what occurred. To protect yourself and your companions for the next set of perils, you gain two 'Grant Guard' effects that can be used on yourself or your companions. You may only use this ability once per Long Rest. If you take a Long Rest after returning from an adventure and do not use this ability, it is lost.
skills.name: Set the Scene

skills.description: Once per event refresh one Long Rest skill. Once per Long Rest, if you create a new or expand upon a existing performance art script or lyrics you can refresh this skill.
skills.name: Composition

skills.description: Once per event, when there is a concert, show, or other grand performance and you perform in that venue, as a reward for yourself for performing, you may 'Grant One Prowess, Insight or Fortitude' to yourself.
skills.name: Grand performance
skills.verbal: Grant 1 Prowess, Insight or Fortitude to self

skills.description: To use this skill you must carry an item representative of your Foundation. Take 3 seconds of Role Play while touching the item and spend a single attribute to purge any mental effect. If the item is on your person and you are affected by a paralyze effect, you can still use this skill.
skills.name: Complete Focus

skills.description: You may pass along your appreciation to someone on their skill in their Foundation. This is a roleplaying choice on your part of what is appropriate. After showing your appreciation you may use a Touch Packet on them for the effect.
skills.name: Complimentary Exchange

skills.description: You gain an additional use per event of each of your per event Foundation Skills.
skills.name: Well Founded

skills.description: Once per Long Rest, if you hold an item of your Foundation while taking a Short Rest, you can use the skill "Fire's Touch, Air's Touch, Water's Touch, Ice's Touch, or Lightning's Touch" without having to spend Void.
skills.name: Tricks of the Trade

skills.description: As with the powers of the moths to hear the voices of the dead, you too can speak and learn from them. You gain the ability to "Speak to Dead" and "Speak to Spirit" of the Dead. This allows you to speak to someone lying dead in front of you, or someone who has turned to spirit after they died.
skills.name: Tongue of the Moth

skills.description: You may carry one of three tokens on you at any time. You can switch your token after a long rest in a place of Peace. 1. Token of Joy - 1 / Long Rest - if you fall unstable and your deathcount reaches 59 seconds you can stabilize. 2. Token of Sorrow - 1 / Long rest you can increase a melee, missile, or packet attack to be "and Agony by Fear". **This is a thread skill.** 3. Token of Wonder - 1 / Long rest, spend two Prowess and "Grant Melee attack Five Damage and Grant Extra Melee attack Five Damage".
skills.name: Carry Token
skills.verbal: Unique skill based on chosen Momento Mori

skills.description: Should you die, you are known to Death as a Remembrancer and may gain additional concessions from Death (or not at their discretion) while you are within death's realm. Invoke within Death's realm upon meeting Death while you are a spirit of the dead, by saying the phrase "I carry the memories of the dead".
skills.name: Friend of Death

skills.description: You can sooth those whose minds are disrupted and disturbed. You can spend one point of Insight to "Cure Mental by Memory"
skills.name: Sooth Memory

skills.description: Select a second Foundation. You can choose to purchase skills from that Foundation as well as your first. This grants you the trait for that foundation. The maximum number of Foundation skills you can take increases by 1. You may choose one of the following Open Skills and gain it at no additional cost: Buckler, Disarm Trap, Pick Locks, Cornucopia, Merchant, Platform, Resourceful, Two Weapons.
skills.name: Skilled Learner

skills.description: Once per Long Rest, you may use any crafting skill or skill with an attribute cost you know the rules for. You do not need to have that skill as a skill you have purchased with CP. If that skill has an attribute cost, you must spend the cost.
skills.name: Fast Learner

skills.description: Select a third Foundation. You can choose to purchase skills from that Foundation as well as your first two. The maximum number of Foundation skills you can take increases by 1. You may choose one of the following Open Skills and gain it at no additional cost: Buckler, Disarm Trap, Pick Locks, Cornucopia, Merchant, Platform, Resourceful, Two Weapons.
skills.name: Multi-talented

skills.description: You gain an additional point of Vitality. This point can allow you to go above the maximum.
skills.name: Hard at Work

skills.description: You gain a pool of two effects either two beneficial packets of 'Heal 2 by Harmony' effects or two packet attacks of '2 Damage by Force.' This pool starts the game empty. Once per Short Rest, When you sing a song of no less than a minute, just because, with no audience or acclaim required, you can choose to refresh this pool. (You may use this ability while taking a Long or Short Rest)
skills.name: Revel in yourself
skills.verbal: 2 Damage by Force' or 'Heal 2 by Harmony

skills.description: When you play a song game or sing a childish tune you can purge a mental effect upon completion of the song.
skills.name: The Song Game

skills.description: When someone speaks to you or sings at you and you answer them back with a song or verse, heal 3 to self. This is not a spell so you do not need your hands free, and you can be in combat while using this ability.
skills.name: Answer with a song

skills.description: When you get a group of people to join you in a song of no less than 30 seconds, your next called damage or healing effect is increased by 3.
skills.name: Choral

skills.description: You keep a chess board, deck of cards or other game in a state of half play in your cabin or a public area that occupies no more than one foot on a side. You may 'Resist' an effect, but in so doing you forfeit the game. To refresh this ability you must reset the game and replay it to the half-played state.
skills.name: Better a Forfeit than a Loss

skills.description: Once per event, you can 'Imbue Short Rest' to another person. Once per Long Rest, while in a Place of Peace, you can renew this ability by playing a game of strategy, insight or luck with one or more opponents.
skills.name: Enjoying the game

skills.description: You have a pool of 3 Grant 2 protection effects. This pool starts game full. You can refresh by spending an attribute when, within a Place of Peace, you win a game you play with another person or persons.
skills.name: The joy of victory

skills.description: Four times per event you can call upon luck and use a skill that requires Fortitude, Insight or Prowess without spending the attribute. When you use the skill start by saying 'By Luck..'
skills.name: Breaking the rules

skills.description: In a Place of Peace, you can grant a melee attack of 2 damage. If you have just completed a Performance, you can use this skill on up to 4 people.
skills.name: Performance of battle

skills.description: When you are in a Place of Peace, skills that allow you to provide multiple beneficial effects, gain an additional effect.
skills.name: Climactic Moment

skills.description: If you are in a Place of Peace, upon completing a Short Rest, you can heal 5 by Water to one person. If instead of a Short Rest you have just completed a performance, you can use this skill on up to 4 people.
skills.name: Performance of recovery

skills.description: Once per Long Rest, You may take a Short Rest and upon completion, treat your current location as a Place of Peace for the purpose of one skill from this Expression. Additionally, this ability allows you to perform while you are taking a Short Rest. If you have this skill, you can perform while you are taking your Short Rest.
skills.name: Find the Stage

skills.description: Twice per event you gain a 4-damage attack when in your place. Pick the type of attack, Melee, Missile, or Spell, when you purchase this ability.
skills.name: Attack

skills.description: Once per event, reduce any damage melee, missile or packet attack to 1 damage.
skills.name: Defense

skills.description: Twice per event you can gift another a 4-damage attack (pick when you take this ability from melee, missile, or magic) when in your place.
skills.name: Boon

skills.description: Once per event, when you tell a war story that occurred during this event or the last event you attended, you can give yourself and the listener a protection effect.
skills.name: War Story

skills.description: Once per event, when you are in your place you gain an additional point of any attribute of your choice. When you leave your place or after your next Long Rest, the point is lost.
skills.name: Home Ground

skills.description: You have a holding which can be a place or a business which represents resources you have related to your Foundation.
skills.name: Holding

skills.description: Once per event, when using a healing or damage effect powered by your Foundation Type, increase the effect by four. **This is an extra Thread Skill.**
skills.name: Enhance

skills.description: Once per event you can try to expose your Specialty by invoking your knowledge. If you are uncertain of your specialty's expose, please consult with Rules staff before using this skill. Some examples include: Astrology: Shade, Magic: Arcane, Theology: Divine, Spirits: Dead or Spirit, Nature: Beast or Plant. Others are allowed, but work with staff for the specifics.
skills.name: Expose

skills.description: Once per event you can make a damage, Agony, or Maim attack with the Trait by your specialty (e.g., 'Arcane', 'Shade', etc.). See above for details for traits.
skills.name: Convert

skills.description: Once per event, when you share something you learned about your Specialty this event or last one to someone you haven't told it to before, you can give yourself and the listener a Protection effect.
skills.name: Share Knowledge

skills.description: Once per event, after you have finished studying or talking about your specialty with others, you gain a point of Insight. That point remains until your next Long Rest.
skills.name: Long Study

skills.description: You have a holding which can be a place or a business which represents resources you have related to your Foundation.
skills.name: Holding

skills.description: Once per event, when using a healing or damage effect powered by your Specialty, increase the effect by four. **This is an extra Thread Skill.**
skills.name: Enhance

skills.description: You have a way of finding Resources. At check in you gain an extra 2 Drakar coin.
skills.name: Discover

skills.description: Once per event you can make a damage, Agony or Maim attack with the Trait 'By Providence'
skills.name: Convert

skills.description: There is an additional list of items for sale from the Guild. Once per event you can purchase one of these items.
skills.name: What's in Back

skills.description: Once per event, when you use a Resource (coin, components, magic items, etc.) you gain a point of Prowess. This point is lost after you take your next Long
skills.name: Shopping Spree

skills.description: You have a holding which can be a place or a business which represents resources you have related to your Foundation.
skills.name: Holding

skills.description: Once per event, if you are roleplaying in an encounter and it turns into a fight, you can turn to Spirit for 10 seconds and move away from the center of the combat
skills.name: Not my Fight

skills.description: Once per event, when there are too many people for a module, you can offer to go as a Spirit instead of a participant. You must stay to the side, avoid combat, and can only talk in whispers.
skills.name: Observer

skills.description: Once per event, when you engage in your signature RP (based on your type of Interaction), you can refresh two points of Insight, Fortitude, or Prowess.
skills.name: Extrovert

skills.description: Once per event, when you engage in your signature RP (based on your type of Interaction) you can refresh two points of Insight, Fortitude, or Prowess to another.
skills.name: Fun to Be Around

skills.description: Once per event, after a social Interaction of your type, you gain a point of Insight. This point is lost after you take your next Long Rest.
skills.name: Mutual Understanding

skills.description: You have a holding which can be a place or a business which represents resources you have related to your Foundation.
skills.name: Holding

skills.description: You are skilled with Basic One Handed Weapon and Basic Two handed weapons as defined in the Weapons section. This skill only grants you the ability to wield a single weapon.
skills.name: Base Weapon Skills

skills.description: who is unstable or repair a maimed limb on yourself or another. You must have at least one free hand to use this skill. You touch another character with a packet. Say the phrase 'Begin First Aid'. First Aid takes one minute. At the end of the minute, you say either 'Stabilize' or 'Cure Maim Limb'. You can touch an individual with a packet
skills.name: First Aid

skills.description: and say 'Diagnose <Trait>' or 'Diagnose <Effect>'. You may only Diagnose a specific Trait and only Traits which are Elemental, Mental, Metabolic, or Physical. You may also diagnose any standard effect, but you may not diagnose inflicts. You may also 'Diagnose Damage' to determine how much damage someone has taken.
skills.name: Diagnose

skills.description: If, during a game, your prop for a specific in-game item breaks you can find an alternative prop and keep playing as though you were using the original prop.
skills.name: Improvisation

skills.description: You may choose not to have Guard effects trigger on uncalled damage. This choice is at your discretion
skills.name: Improved Guard

skills.description: You can wear 'Light Armor' as described in the armor section.
skills.name: Wear Light Armor

skills.description: Spend one minute of Focus. At the end of the minute you repair all of the points of Armor you are currently wearing.
skills.name: Repair Armor

skills.description: As one of the Purposed people of the world you start game with the 'Purposed' trait.
skills.name: Purposed

skills.description: As a Living being in the world you start game with the Living trait.
skills.name: Living

skills.description: You get the benefit of wearing light armor without having to wear armor. This includes the ability to use skills or items which affect armor by applying them to your costuming instead. **Agility only replaces the need for a Light Armor phys rep. If you want the benefits of Medium or Heavy armor, you must wear the appropriate phys rep for that armor type.**
skills.name: Agility

skills.description: You can use a bow or crossbow in combat. You may block with your bow, but not wield a weapon in your other hand. You get 5 shots, to prepare 5 more shots you must Short Rest. Called missile effects do not count against the number of shots in your quiver. If you block an attack with your bow or crossbow, your bow cannot be used for any missile attacks, either called or uncalled, until you take a 10 second Rest. Note: Core rules specifically say if you miss with a missile attack, or it is blocked you do not use up the attributes. (You do use one of your arrows from your quiver)
skills.name: Archery

skills.description: Use a buckler in combat. You can wield in combat any one handed weapon you are skilled with.
skills.name: Buckler

skills.description: Between events you can send a Yes/ No question about something you learned in-game that is related to cosmological events. You will receive a reply that will confirm or refute the information in a 100% certain answer. An example might be 'I learned at this event there are 5 Genesori, is this true?' The answer you would get to this question is yes or no. You can send two of these per event.
skills.name: True Sight

skills.description: When you sell an OOG item for in-game coin while in a Place of Peace, you can use a touch packet on the person who purchased the item to 'heal all'.
skills.name: Cornucopia

skills.description: You can send a physical message across the Lattice to a recipient that you have met and been formally or informally introduced to or for whom you have a skill or plot effect granting you the ability to reach out to that person. For example, if you saw the Monarch of your country from the other side of a building, that is not an introduction. However, if you went before them and your name given to them, then you have been introduced. This is a physical letter, while it travels the magics of the Lattice and therefore can arrive in a short time, letters **cannot** be sent to great beings of the Shade or spirits of the dead or similar beings who don't get mail. **As this is a letter and there is no guarantee they will respond, but cultural expectations say they will.**
skills.name: Courier

skills.description: You can use tools or your hands to disable traps you find in-game. You cannot destroy any item or prop in-game without an NPC's permission. That means, unless told so, you cannot cut lines, break boxes, or otherwise damage the props. You will be given clear guidance if you can do such things as part of disarming a trap.
skills.name: Disarm Traps

skills.description: You may also take a Short Rest while spending time to repair armor. If you have a skill which reduces the time required for either your Short Rest or your armor repair, this skill does not reduce the time for the second activity.
skills.name: Effortless Armor Repair

skills.description: You gain the ability to use hafted weapons (72').
skills.name: Hafted Weapons

skills.description: When you take a Long Rest in a Place of Peace with a group of people no larger than 6 including yourself, use a touch packet to 'heal all' to everyone in the circle.
skills.name: Healing Circle

skills.description: You can wield magic to heal a minor wound
skills.name: Healing Touch

skills.description: You can wield magical forces to conjure a packet attack of 3 damage by force.
skills.name: Magical Strike

skills.description: You may wear up to 3 points of armor.
skills.name: Medium Armor

skills.description: When you check in you gain 3 coins. Additionally, you can sell out of game items for in-game coin.
skills.name: Merchant

skills.description: Certain challenges will be identified as a "lock". You cannot engage on solving that puzzle (which may be picking an actual lock) if you do not have this skill.
skills.name: Pick Locks

skills.description: You can bring a stone / platform with you that is no larger than 30 inches on any side. You can lay this platform down and pick it up at will. Once laid on the ground it acts as safe ground on any terrain effect.
skills.name: Platform

skills.description: 1x / Short Rest, if you would take an effect from a terrain effect such as Lava or a Pit on the floor, you can avoid the effect. *You can purchase this skill up to 3 times.*
skills.name: Quick Reflexes

skills.description: From your foundation and culture you can gain research topics. If you have access to a research topic you can submit a research request on a given topic. This skill does not provide topics by default. Topics can be earned in game through role play or purchased from your Culture or Foundation. When you submit a question, plot will reply with details on the topic. If the question is too broad or very deep, then plot may reply with some information and say, "There is more information here, but I don't have time to include it now". That means if you want the additional information, you should submit a continuation of research request the next event. *You will be able to gain additional research topics through the game.*
skills.name: Research

skills.description: When you check in for the event you gain 2 random components.
skills.name: Resourceful

skills.description: Use a shield in combat. You can wield in combat any basic one handed weapon you are skilled with.
skills.name: Shield

skills.description: You can turn on a non-candle light prop for yourself. You can hand it out, but you can't create a new one for yourself till you get it back or the next night. The prop should not be brighter than a glow stick. *Note: You should not wear this around your neck, as that is reserved for people with medical conditions for visibility.* *Note: As a courtesy rule, if someone asks you to turn off or cover the light due to its brightness, please do.*
skills.name: Summon Light

skills.description: In your cabin or another not majorly public area, or during a special event in the tavern, you can set up background music. Note: As a courtesy rule, if someone asks you to turn off the music, please do.
skills.name: Summon Music

skills.description: You may carry and use throwing weapons. When you pick up a weapon off the ground, you must take 10 seconds of activity to clean and prepare the weapon before it may be thrown again. Note, that all your collected weapons can be prepared simultaneously. You must take a Short Rest between uses of Thrown Weapons.
skills.name: Thrown Weapons

skills.description: Use two weapons up to 46' each.
skills.name: Two Weapon fighting

skills.description: You can wield a weapon to make a melee attack for 3 damage.
skills.name: Weapon Strike
